title: Get Up Close with Sharks at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium
description:
Celebrate Shark Week at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, where visitors can dive into the fascinating world of sharks during AZA Shark and Ray Awareness Day. This special event offers a rare chance to explore museum specimens that aren't normally on display, including shark jaws from different species, great white shark vertebrae, and even real shark skin you can touch.

Beyond the special exhibits, Cabrillo Marine Aquarium offers a science-based, hands-on experience for visitors of all ages. Learn about marine life through detailed biological illustrations, discover the anatomy of sharks, octopuses, and other sea creatures, and explore exhibits featuring both common and scientific species names. Guests can also enjoy crafts, activities, giveaways, and educational experiences designed to inspire curiosity about ocean conservation.

Admission to Cabrillo Marine Aquarium is always free, making it an affordable family destination in the Port of Los Angeles. Parking at Cabrillo Beach is available for a fee.

Learn more and plan your visit: https://www.cabrillomarineaquarium.org
